title: The School Clock
question: 把今天“公共时间 -> 保持准确 -> 被检查/同步 -> 很少出错 -> 小设置错误导致时间不准”的表达，放进 school central clock 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: Our school clock is extremely accurate because everyone uses it for classes and activities. The staff have it checked every morning, and it is connected to the school network. It has rarely gone wrong. Once, however, it failed to give the correct time because a small setting error slowed it down. Shared time must be accurate, or everyone gets confused.
word_bank: failed to give the correct time
